<!doctype html>
<!DOCTYPE html>

<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8"/>
<meta content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1" name="viewport"/>
<title>Endrit Akinci — Portfolio 2026</title>
<style>
:root {
  --paper:#f3f2ee;
  --ink:#151515;
  --red:#ff2a19;
  --rule:#d3d0c7;
  --grid:rgba(20,20,20,.10);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{margin:0;color:var(--ink);background:#111;font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;overflow-x:hidden}
img,video{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
.paper{
  background:
  linear-gradient(var(--grid) 1px,transparent 1px),
  linear-gradient(90deg,var(--grid) 1px,transparent 1px),
  radial-gradient(circle at 70% 12%,rgba(0,0,0,.025),transparent 28%),
  var(--paper);
  background-size:38px 38px,38px 38px,100% 100%,100% 100%;
}
.wrap{width:min(1200px,88vw);margin:auto}
.tiny{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.05em}
.hand{font-family:"Comic Sans MS","Bradley Hand",cursive}
.reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(30px);transition:.7s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.reveal.on{opacity:1;transform:none}

/* HERO — much closer to reference */
.hero{min-height:100vh;display:grid;place-items:center;position:relative;padding:60px 0}
.hero-inner{width:min(1100px,88vw);position:relative}
.hero-role{position:absolute;left:5%;top:-38px;font-size:21px;font-weight:900}
.hero-year{position:absolute;right:7%;top:-38px;font-size:20px;font-weight:900}
.hero-title{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:4px;
  font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.09em;
  font-size:clamp(70px,11.4vw,170px);line-height:.8;white-space:nowrap
}
.hero-person{
  position:relative;
  display:inline-flex;
  align-items:center;
  justify-content:center;
  flex:0 0 auto;
  margin:0 -3px;
  letter-spacing:0 !important;
  font-size:initial;
  line-height:normal;
}
.hero-avatar{
  width:clamp(92px,8.8vw,138px);
  height:clamp(122px,11.7vw,184px);
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center;
  border-radius:0;
  mix-blend-mode:multiply;
  margin:-18px 0 -24px;
  flex:0 0 auto;
}
.hero-name{
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:calc(100% + 18px);
  transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg);
  font-family:"Comic Sans MS","Bradley Hand",cursive;
  font-size:clamp(14px,1.35vw,20px);
  font-weight:700;
  line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:0 !important;
  white-space:nowrap;
  z-index:6;
  color:var(--ink);
  background:var(--paper);
  padding:3px 7px 4px;
  border-radius:3px;
}
.hero-name:before{
  content:"↑";
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:-24px;
  transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-8deg);
  font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;
  font-size:18px;
  font-weight:900;
  line-height:1;
  letter-spacing:0;
}
.hero-stars{text-align:center;font-size:44px;letter-spacing:10px;margin-top:100px}
.hero-sub{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-95px;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em}

/* HELLO */
.hello{padding:120px 0 120px;position:relative}
.hello-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.88fr 1.35fr .78fr;gap:48px;align-items:center}
.cutout{height:610px;position:relative}
.cutout:before{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  left:8%;right:8%;top:2%;bottom:0;
  border:2px solid #e86d63;
  z-index:2;
  pointer-events:none;
}
.cutout img{
  position:absolute;
  left:8%;right:8%;top:2%;bottom:0;
  width:84%;height:98%;
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position:center top;
  z-index:1;
}
.hello-copy h2{font-size:clamp(74px,8vw,125px);line-height:.72;margin:0 0 28px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.07em}
.hello-copy h4{margin:0 0 15px;font-size:16px}
.hello-copy p{font-size:14px;line-height:1.45;margin:0 0 20px;max-width:580px}
.edu-title{font-size:23px;font-weight:1000;margin-top:34px;margin-bottom:12px}
.edu-list{display:grid;gap:12px;max-width:600px}
.edu-item{padding-top:10px;border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.edu-item:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:0}
.edu-item b{font-size:14px}
.edu-item span{display:block;font-size:12px;line-height:1.45;margin-top:2px}
.side h3{font-size:27px;margin:0 0 17px;font-weight:1000}
.skills{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,66px);
  gap:14px;
  margin-bottom:35px
}
.app{
  width:66px;height:66px;
  border-radius:13px;
  display:grid;
  place-items:center;
  background:#fff;
  border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.14);
  box-shadow:0 4px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.045);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.app img{
  display:block;
  width:48px;
  height:48px;
  object-fit:contain;
}
.app.canva img{
  width:55px;
  height:auto;
  max-height:38px;
}
.app.capcut img{
  width:47px;
  height:47px;
}
.app-fallback{display:none;}
.side p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.4;margin:0 0 15px}
.side b{font-size:14px}
.torn{height:110px;background:#111;clip-path:polygon(0 47%,4% 59%,9% 40%,14% 63%,20% 44%,25% 62%,31% 42%,37% 63%,44% 40%,50% 60%,56% 44%,63% 64%,69% 41%,75% 62%,82% 43%,88% 64%,94% 44%,100% 59%,100% 100%,0 100%);margin-top:-45px}

/* STUDIO / polaroids */
.studio{padding:80px 0 130px}
.studio h2{text-align:center;font-size:48px;margin:0 0 65px;font-weight:1000}
.polaroids{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:0;align-items:center}
.polaroid{
  width:min(24vw,285px);
  background:#f1eee5;
  padding:12px 12px 56px;
  box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.16);
  position:relative;
}
.polaroid:nth-child(1){transform:rotate(-9deg)} .polaroid:nth-child(2){transform:rotate(5deg) translateY(25px)} .polaroid:nth-child(3){transform:rotate(9deg)}
.polaroid video{
  width:100%;
  aspect-ratio:9/16;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center;
  background:#000;
}
.polaroid p{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:8px;font-size:12px;margin:0}
.tape{position:absolute;width:80px;height:18px;background:rgba(234,218,166,.75);top:-8px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%) rotate(-3deg);z-index:2}

/* CATEGORY COVER exactly more Behance-like */
.cat{height:650px;position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;color:#fff;overflow:hidden;background:#151515}
.cat-media{
  position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position:center;
  filter:brightness(.42) saturate(.9);
}
.cat:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.38),rgba(0,0,0,.08))}
.cat-content{position:relative;z-index:2;width:min(1200px,88vw);margin:auto}
.cat-kicker{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:18px}
.cat h2{font-size:clamp(78px,11vw,170px);color:var(--red);line-height:.73;letter-spacing:-.075em;margin:0;font-weight:1000}
.cat-nav{position:absolute;z-index:3;left:0;right:0;top:22px;display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:30px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em}

/* VIDEO PROJECTS — editorial, not rounded cards */
.projects{padding:90px 0 130px}
.project-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);padding-bottom:12px;margin-bottom:42px}
.project-head h2{font-size:54px;margin:0;letter-spacing:-.05em}
.project-head p{max-width:420px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}
.video-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:52px 30px;
  align-items:start;
}
.vitem{position:relative}
.vframe{
  background:#000;
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  aspect-ratio:9/16;
  overflow:hidden;
  width:100%;
}
.vframe video{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:center;
  background:#000;
}
.vmeta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid var(--ink);margin-top:9px}
.vmeta h3{margin:0;font-size:19px}.vmeta span{font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em}
.vitem:nth-child(2),.vitem:nth-child(4){margin-top:0}

/* LOGO wall similar to reference */
.logo-wall{padding:0}
.logo-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.logo-cell{height:320px;display:grid;place-items:center;border-right:1px solid #bbb5a9;border-bottom:1px solid #bbb5a9;position:relative;background:#f3f0e7}
.logo-cell img{max-width:62%;max-height:160px;object-fit:contain}
.logo-cell small{position:absolute;bottom:16px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.12em;font-weight:900}

/* DESIGN WORKS GALLERY */
.design-case{padding:100px 0 130px}
.design-grid.design-gallery{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:24px;
  align-items:start;
}
.design-gallery .design-card{
  background:#eee9de;
  padding:12px;
  box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.10);
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.design-gallery .design-card img{
  width:100%;
  height:auto;
  display:block;
  object-fit:contain;
  background:#f8f5ed;
}
.design-gallery .caption{
  position:static;
  display:inline-block;
  margin-top:12px;
  background:var(--paper);
  padding:9px 12px;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:900;
  transform:none;
}
@media(max-width:1200px){
  .design-grid.design-gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .design-grid.design-gallery{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:600px){
  .design-grid.design-gallery{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

/* SPORTS */
.sports{padding:100px 0 120px}
.sports-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:24px}
.sport{background:#eee9de;padding:10px 10px 45px;position:relative;box-shadow:0 10px 22px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
.sport:nth-child(odd){transform:rotate(-1.5deg)}.sport:nth-child(even){transform:rotate(1.5deg)}
.sport h3{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:13px;font-size:15px;margin:0}

/* Experience */
.info{padding:110px 0}
.info h2{font-size:clamp(70px,10vw,150px);line-height:.72;letter-spacing:-.07em;margin:0 0 60px}
.info-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);border-top:2px solid var(--ink)}
.info-card{padding:25px 24px 35px;border-right:1px solid var(--ink);min-height:250px}
.info-card:last-child{border-right:0}.info-card .year{color:var(--red);font-size:11px;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:28px}
.info-card h3{font-size:27px;margin:0 0 6px}.info-card h4{font-size:13px;margin:0 0 18px}.info-card p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.5}

/* CONTACT */
.contact{min-height:88vh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:100px 0}
.contact h2{font-size:clamp(75px,12vw,180px);line-height:.7;letter-spacing:-.08em;margin:0}
.contact h2 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--red)}
.contact-links{margin-top:60px;border-top:2px solid var(--ink);padding-top:18px;display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.contact-links a{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;border:1.5px solid var(--ink);padding:10px 14px}
.contact-links a:first-child{background:var(--ink);color:#fff}

.logo-cover{background:#151515}
.logo-cover .cat-media{
  object-fit:contain;
  object-position:75% center;
  padding:8% 8% 8% 48%;
  filter:brightness(.68) grayscale(1);
}
@media(max-width:1050px){
  .video-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
}
@media(max-width:800px){
  .hero-role,.hero-year{font-size:11px;top:-18px}.hero-title{font-size:22vw}.hero-avatar{width:72px;height:96px;margin:-10px 0 -14px;object-fit:contain}
  .hero-name{font-size:12px;left:50%;top:calc(100% + 14px);letter-spacing:0!important}.hero-stars{margin-top:80px}
  .hello-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.cutout{height:450px}.hello-copy h2{font-size:80px}
  .polaroids{flex-direction:column;gap:30px}.polaroid{width:80vw;transform:none!important}
  .cat{height:520px}.cat h2{font-size:18vw}
  .video-grid,.design-grid,.sports-row,.info-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.vitem{margin-top:0!important}
  .logo-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.info-card{border-right:0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink)}
}

.experience-side{
  display:block;
  margin-top:34px;
  width:100%;
}
.experience-side h3{
  margin:0 0 18px;
}
.experience-item{
  display:block;
  width:100%;
  padding:12px 0;
  border-top:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.22);
}
.experience-item:first-of-type{
  border-top:0;
  padding-top:0;
}
.experience-item b{
  display:block;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.3;
  margin-bottom:3px;
}
.experience-item span{
  display:block;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.35;
}


.experience-grid-4{
  grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);
}
.experience-grid-4 .info-card h4{
  line-height:1.35;
}
@media(max-width:1100px){
  .experience-grid-4{
    grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);
  }
  .experience-grid-4 .info-card{
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--ink);
  }
}
@media(max-width:800px){
  .experience-grid-4{
    grid-template-columns:1fr;
  }
}


/* AI VIDEO EDITING */
.ai-category{
  height:650px;
  position:relative;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  color:#fff;
  overflow:hidden;
  background:#121212;
}
.ai-category video{
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position:center;
  filter:brightness(.40) saturate(.9);
}
.ai-category:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:
    linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.72),rgba(0,0,0,.10)),
    radial-gradient(circle at 74% 36%,rgba(255,42,25,.35),transparent 28%);
}
.ai-category .cat-content{position:relative;z-index:2}
.ai-category h2{
  font-size:clamp(72px,10.5vw,165px);
  line-height:.72;
  letter-spacing:-.075em;
  color:var(--red);
  margin:0;
  font-weight:1000;
}
.ai-section{padding:95px 0 135px}
.ai-head{
  display:flex;
  align-items:end;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:28px;
  border-bottom:2px solid var(--ink);
  padding-bottom:13px;
  margin-bottom:42px;
}
.ai-head h2{
  margin:0;
  font-size:clamp(50px,7vw,105px);
  line-height:.78;
  letter-spacing:-.055em;
}
.ai-head p{
  max-width:470px;
  font-size:13px;
  line-height:1.55;
}
.ai-grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
  gap:46px 28px;
  align-items:start;
}
.ai-card{
  position:relative;
}
.ai-frame{
  aspect-ratio:9/16;
  background:#000;
  border:2px solid var(--ink);
  overflow:hidden;
}
.ai-frame video{
  width:100%;
  height:100%;
  object-fit:contain;
  background:#000;
}
.ai-meta{
  display:flex;
  justify-content:space-between;
  gap:15px;
  align-items:flex-start;
  border-top:1px solid var(--ink);
  margin-top:9px;
  padding-top:11px;
}
.ai-meta h3{
  margin:0;
  font-size:18px;
  line-height:1.05;
}
.ai-meta span{
  font-size:9px;
  line-height:1.3;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
  text-align:right;
}
.ai-card:nth-child(2){margin-top:65px}
.ai-card:nth-child(5){margin-top:-65px}

@media(max-width:1050px){
  .ai-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .ai-card{margin-top:0!important}
}
@media(max-width:800px){
  .ai-category{height:520px}
  .ai-category h2{font-size:17vw}
  .ai-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .ai-head{display:block}
  .ai-head p{margin-top:15px}
}


.sound-help{
  position:fixed;
  right:18px;
  bottom:18px;
  z-index:999;
  background:#111;
  color:#fff;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);
  padding:10px 14px;
  font-size:11px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
  box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.22);
  cursor:pointer;
  user-select:none;
}
.sound-help.active{
  background:var(--red);
  color:#fff;
}
@media(max-width:800px){
  .sound-help{right:10px;bottom:10px;font-size:10px;padding:9px 11px}
}


.vframe{position:relative}
.vframe:has(video[data-regular-video="1"])::after{
  content:"▶ PLAY WITH SOUND";
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:5;
  padding:9px 12px;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.78);
  color:#fff;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
  pointer-events:none;
  white-space:nowrap;
  transition:.2s ease;
}
.vframe:has(video[data-regular-video="1"].is-playing)::after{
  opacity:0;
}


video[data-force-sound="1"]{
  cursor:pointer;
}
.vframe:has(video[data-force-sound="1"])::after,
.ai-frame:has(video[data-force-sound="1"])::after{
  content:"▶ PLAY — SOUND ON";
  position:absolute;
  left:50%;
  top:50%;
  transform:translate(-50%,-50%);
  z-index:9;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.82);
  color:#fff;
  padding:9px 12px;
  font-size:10px;
  font-weight:900;
  letter-spacing:.08em;
  pointer-events:none;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.vframe:has(video[data-force-sound="1"].is-playing)::after,
.ai-frame:has(video[data-force-sound="1"].is-playing)::after{
  opacity:0;
}
.ai-frame{position:relative}


@media(max-width:1200px){
  .video-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .vitem{margin-top:0!important}
  .ai-card{margin-top:0!important}
}


/* VIDEO EDITING — strict 3 x 3 grouped layout */
.video-grid{
  display:grid !important;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr)) !important;
  gap:46px 28px !important;
  align-items:start !important;
}
.video-grid .vitem{
  margin-top:0 !important;
  transform:none !important;
}
@media(max-width:1050px){
  .video-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr)) !important;}
}
@media(max-width:700px){
  .video-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr !important;}
}


/* V22 bilingual controls */
.lang-switch{position:fixed;top:18px;right:18px;z-index:1200;display:none;gap:8px;background:rgba(248,244,236,.94);padding:8px;border:1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.14);box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.08);backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
body.lang-selected .lang-switch{display:flex}.lang-switch button,.language-choice button{border:2px solid var(--ink);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);padding:10px 16px;font:inherit;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em;cursor:pointer}.lang-switch button.active,.language-choice button.active{background:var(--ink);color:var(--paper)}
.language-choice{margin-top:26px;text-align:center}.language-choice .choose-copy{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:12px}.language-choice .choose-actions{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
@media(max-width:800px){.lang-switch{top:10px;right:10px}.lang-switch button,.language-choice button{padding:9px 12px;font-size:11px}}
</style>
</head>
<body><div class="lang-switch" id="langSwitch"><button data-lang="en" type="button">EN</button><button data-lang="sq" type="button">SQ</button></div>
<section class="hero paper">
<div class="hero-inner reveal">
<div class="hero-role">VIDEO EDITOR / CREATOR</div>
<div class="hero-year">2026</div>
<div class="hero-title">
<span>PORTF</span>
<span class="hero-person"><img alt="" class="hero-avatar" src="data:image/jpeg;base64,"/><span class="hero-name hand">Endrit Akinci</span></span>
<span>LIO</span>
</div>
<div class="hero-stars">✦ ◆ ✤</div><div class="language-choice" id="languageChoice"><div class="choose-copy">CHOOSE YOUR LANGUAGE / ZGJIDH GJUHËN</div><div class="choose-actions"><button data-lang="en" type="button">ENGLISH</button><button data-lang="sq" type="button">SHQIP</button></div></div>

  const nodes=[];
  const walker=document.createTreeWalker(document.body,NodeFilter.SHOW_TEXT,{acceptNode(n){const p=n.parentElement;if(!p||/^(SCRIPT|STYLE|NOSCRIPT)$/.test(p.tagName)||p.closest('#languageChoice,#langSwitch'))return NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;const k=n.nodeValue.trim();return k&&Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(SQ,k)?NodeFilter.FILTER_ACCEPT:NodeFilter.FILTER_REJECT;}});
  let n; while((n=walker.nextNode())){const raw=n.nodeValue,k=raw.trim(),i=raw.indexOf(k);nodes.push({n,k,pre:raw.slice(0,i),post:raw.slice(i+k.length)});}
  function setLang(lang,fromChoice){lang=lang==='sq'?'sq':'en';nodes.forEach(x=>x.n.nodeValue=x.pre+(lang==='sq'?SQ[x.k]:x.k)+x.post);document.documentElement.lang=lang==='sq'?'sq':'en';document.body.classList.add('lang-selected');document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active',b.dataset.lang===lang));if(fromChoice){const h=document.querySelector('.hello');if(h)setTimeout(()=>h.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth',block:'start'}),100);}}
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang]').forEach(b=>b.addEventListener('click',()=>setLang(b.dataset.lang,!!b.closest('#languageChoice'))));
  // keep portrait/media identical for both languages; never touch src/poster attributes.
  window.setPortfolioLanguage=setLang;
})();
</script><script>
(function(){document.querySelectorAll('video[data-force-sound="1"]').forEach(v=>{v.autoplay=false;v.muted=false;v.controls=true;});})();
</script>
<script id="githubPortraitFix">
(function(){
  const portraitPath='assets/images/portrait.png';
  function ensurePortrait(){
    const cutout=document.querySelector('.hello .cutout');
    if(!cutout) return;
    let img=cutout.querySelector('img');
    if(!img){ img=document.createElement('img'); cutout.appendChild(img); }
    img.alt='Endrit Akinci';
    img.src=portraitPath;
    img.style.display='block';
    img.style.visibility='visible';
    img.style.opacity='1';
  }
  if(document.readyState==='loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',ensurePortrait); else ensurePortrait();
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lang]').forEach(btn=>btn.addEventListener('click',()=>{ensurePortrait();setTimeout(ensurePortrait,50);setTimeout(ensurePortrait,250);}));
})();
</script>
